newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SA PINTO BAN PUTS MOVE TO SPAIN IN DOUBT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SA PINTO BAN PUTS MOVE TO SPAIN IN DOUBT.

text.p: Portugal's soccer federation has banned Sporting Lisbon's Ricardo Sa Pinto for assaulting national squad coach Artur Jorge, throwing into doubt a $4 million move to Spain's Real Sociedad.
Portuguese media reported on Friday that the temperamental striker had been barred for 12 months but federation officials would only confirm a suspension without spelling out the length of the ban.
It was also not immediately clear whether the ban would be valid outside Portugal and so block his agreed transfer to the Spanish first division side.
Sa Pinto struck Jorge at the national team's training ground in March after being left out of the squad. He said that he was angry at news reports that he had been excluded for disciplinary problems.
